meta.title: ATHLETIX — Train Like an Athlete | Brisbane Strength & Conditioning
meta.description: Elite strength and conditioning in Fortitude Valley, Brisbane. Small group classes, athlete programs, allied health and NDIS support.

hero.lede: You don't have to be an athlete to train like one. Experience challenging, exciting and unique small-group fitness classes, led by elite strength and conditioning coaches the pros train with.

manifesto.heading: Teamwork combined with science is the secret that makes common people achieve uncommon results.
manifesto.body: Athletix is an elite athletic development centre in Fortitude Valley. Whether you're chasing a podium or your first pull-up, our coaches use data-driven programming built on the same principles that shape professional sport.

team.heading: OUR ELITE COACHES
team.sub: All our coaches are members of the 2 major national organisations for exercise professionals and strength and conditioning (ASCA and ESSA). They have merged their degrees with on-the-field expertise, cooperating with some of the major high-performance institutions in Australia.

trial.heading: $7 for 7 days. Unlimited access.
trial.body: All classes included. Fully refundable. Meet the coaches, test the floor, and see why athletes across Brisbane train with us.
